# Salesflare | Product Overview

Salesflare is an automated entry CRM designed for small B2B sales teams to reduce maintenance via email, calendar, website, and LinkedIn signals. The product core creates a unified workspace around customer relationships, sales execution and revenue processes, reducing dispersed tools and manual maintenance.
